feeds.title: Kerstin Hahn Photography Blog
feeds.description: Come find all the tools, tips, and inspiration over on my wedding photographer blog. It's my job to make your day the best it can be! Photographing intimate weddings, elopements and love stories in Montreal and around the world, I'm here to capture the wedding celebration that truly reflects who you are.

feeds.title: Elegant Wedding
feeds.description: Elegant Wedding is your one-stop blog, magazine, show, and wedding directory dedicated to helping brides find the best inspiration for their big day! Elegant Wedding is about unparalleled elegance, true style and sophistication inspiring creativity.

feeds.title: Dream It Yourself Blog
feeds.description: Dream It Yourself Montreal is the first wedding dress boutique in Quebec that is entirely dedicated to contemporary brides. With our resolutely bohemian & modern wedding dresses, Dream It Yourself accompanies all the brides-to-be in Montreal in the realization of a wedding at their image, unique and current. Explore our blog for wedding planning tips, trending bride dress designs, decor trends and more!

feeds.title: Micheal Beaulieu
feeds.description: Creative Montreal Wedding & Adventure Session photography journal. View inspiration for engagement sessions, elopement photography, and unique destination and local weddings. Micheal Beaulieu is an award-winning Montreal wedding photographer known for creating gorgeous and natural-looking wedding portraits. His wedding photography and emotional portraits have been featured and published in Junebug, once wed, and is available for elopements, engaged adventure sessions, family portraits and Canadian destination weddings.

feeds.title: Lucy Baum Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lucy, a Montreal wedding and family photographer serving Montreal, the West Island of Montreal and surrounding areas. Available for travel regionally and nationally. Browse through my blog as I solidify the moments people cherish for the lifetime from weddings, engagements, and elopements with my quirky photographs.

feeds.title: Ashley MacPhee Photography Blog
feeds.description: Ashley MacPhee's style is modern and style-driven, uniquely designed to capture the real and spontaneous moments as they naturally unfold. We travel internationally and are ready to discuss your needs, wants and desires for your photos on your wedding day! Explore some of the weddings we have captured in the blog.

feeds.title: MTL Wedding Blog
feeds.description: MTL Wedding Blog is Montreal's premier site for wedding inspiration and ideas. Here at MTL Wedding Blog we'll be showcasing the best that our city has to offer from unique venues and details to the very best wedding vendors in the Montreal area. You'll find stunning real weddings and beautiful photography and plenty of inspiration if you're planning a Montreal wedding of your own.

feeds.title: Life by Selena Photography Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of Montreal portrait and wedding photographer Selena Phillips-Boyle. Explore her signature photojournalistic style and stay up to date on her latest wedding and portrait photography projects here. Selena Phillips-Boyle is a portrait photographer living in Tiohtià:ke (Montréal, Canada) working at the intersections of labour, gender and mental health. Their identity as a queer woman shapes their work as a photographer, and compels them to examine topics from the intimate perspectives of cis women, trans, and non-binary folks.

feeds.title: Ioan Films Blog
feeds.description: Here at Ioan Films, we absolutely believe that each wedding is unique, consequently, each wedding film we create should be one of its kind as well. Explore our blog - a Montreal Wedding and Event Videography Journal. Ioan Films is a Montreal-based wedding and lifestyle cinematography studio led by the husband-and-wife duo Rob and Christina Cato.

feeds.title: Lori Waltenbury Photo Blog
feeds.description: Detailed blog posts by Lori Waltenbury Photo, one of Toronto & Montreal's top wedding photographers on wedding photography tips, dos and don'ts and more! Lori captures how your life looks and feels from the inside, the intimate connections you have with your friends and family, and the emotions you experience together in this brief but formidable moment in time.

feeds.title: Alain Photography » Wedding
feeds.description: I am Alain. I photograph corporate events, parties, birthdays, anniversaries, and weddings. Discover all the wedding stories I have captured in the wedding section.

feeds.title: Ness Photography Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ines and I am the photographer behind Ness Photography. When I first picked up a camera, I started seeing the world differently and fell in love with telling people's story through my lens. Since then, I developed my technique and approach in order to document the world around me in a photojournalistic, natural and creative way. This blog is my journal of the moments I captured of weddings, engagements, lifestyle branding and family photos.

feeds.title: Melinda & Keith Photography Blog
feeds.description: Montreal wedding photographers, Melinda and Keith, provide wedding photography to the Montreal city area. Melinda and Keith photograph engagements, weddings, casuals, lifestyle, maternity, portraits, newborns, family, and pets. We take pride in offering the Montreal and surrounding Quebec areas the type of wedding photography they are looking for. Check out the blog for wedding photography tips, shots inspirations, recent captures and more!
